images.name: P1
images.prompt: Traditional Persian and Turkish shadow puppet theatre: intricate cut-leather silhouette puppets with lace-like ornamental cutouts and jointed limbs, pressed against a glowing warm amber parchment screen lit from behind by oil lamps, soft light falloff and vignette at the edges, faint visible puppet rods, colored translucent leather accents in deep red and teal, theatrical, handmade, vertical composition. No text, letters or numbers. A hunter puppet with a bow and a cloth bag walks over a curved hill on the left, a big round rising sun disc behind him; on the right a small net with a cat puppet trapped inside.
